patthana16.90:1.1: arūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassana appaṭigho na arūpāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā cha.
patthana16.90:2.1: anidassana appaṭighaṃ na arūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na sanidassana sappaṭigho na na arūpāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi. anidassana appaṭighaṃ
